skeleton: crab facing the viewer: root on the ground under the body; body (the round shell) with a belly bone for squash; face on the body with the mouth; stalkL/stalkR rooted behind the top of the body, each with an eye bone at its tip carrying the eye ball (face pieces; the eye bones undo their stalk's stretch); clawL/clawR (arm and claw, open or shut) at the shoulders on the body's sides; four walking legs a side at the hips (legL1-4, legR1-4, the far one shaded).

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a cheerful orange-red crab character. Draw this exact crab as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the body: the round orange-red crab shell body with its cream belly and little spots, facing the viewer as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; without its claws, legs or eyes; its top a smooth rounded edge.
2. one eye stalk: a short, thick orange stalk with no eye on its tip, both ends rounded.
3. one big claw with its arm, open: the claw on the left of image 1 with its arm, from a rounded shoulder end to the big claw, its pincers open as in image 1.
4. the same big claw with its arm, its pincers shut, closed together.
5. one walking leg: the lowest leg on the left of image 1, a slim, curved, jointed orange leg with a pointed tip, its top (hip) end rounded.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or another part) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a cheerful orange-red crab character; image 2 shows the same crab cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the crab's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the crab in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. one of the crab's eyes as it is in image 1: only the round eye ball — the white eye with its big dark pupil and white sparkle, in its thin orange rim — the ball alone, with NO stalk or head below it, its bottom edge a full round curve like the rest of the ball. Every eye below is this same ball, alone.
2. the same ball with the eye wide open and surprised: the pupil smaller, the white bigger, with its sparkle.
3. the same ball with the eye gently closed in sleep: an orange lid shut over it, a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same ball with the eye closed in a happy smile: an orange lid, an upward-curving arc.
5. the same ball with the eye sad: looking down, its orange upper lid drooping, tilted towards the middle.
6. the same ball with the eye squeezed shut, crying: an orange lid shut tight in a creased, downward-curving line.
7. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile line.
8. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
9. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
10. the mouth in a small sad frown.
11. the mouth open in a wobbly crying wail, its corners turned down, the inside pink.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

animations.description: the crab does a happy dance, clicking its claws

pause.shows: the crab with both claws raised wide open, mid-dance, grinning

animations.description: the crab scuttles sideways to the left on its eight legs, claws up, then stops.
the crab claps its big claws together, snapping them shut, clack, clack, clack, and grins.
the crab waves hello with one big claw.
the crab turns its eye stalks one way, then the other, then back.
the crab stretches its eye stalks up tall and peers hard at something, then pulls them back down.

pause.shows: the crab with both eye stalks stretched up tall, peering

animations.description: the crab shuffles a few steps sideways and back again, tip-tap on its little legs.
the crab crouches, jumps up high for joy with its claws in the air, and lands with a little squash.
the crab laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the crab talks, its mouth moving, its eye stalks bobbing a little.
the crab shivers and trembles, cold or scared, its claws pulled in.
the crab cries, eye stalks drooping, claws down, its shell shaking with little sobs.
the crab gives a big yawn, lowers its claws and eye stalks and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.

pause.shows: the crab fast asleep, eyes shut, eye stalks and claws drooping

animations.description: the crab nods yes, twice, bobbing its eye stalks.
the crab shakes its eye stalks no.
